source: BK3 printed pp.40-41 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.46-47; wires image-read on PDF p.46 at 400 dpi; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Speculative (Step 7): every expect is derived by hand from the wiring and the p.41 formula A X B X C(not) + D = E; the page prints no lamp state for any button combination (A/III-NOT is trace-only). Topology: 1+ feeds the arms 1Y and 4Y. Series branch 1Y-1X(N.O.)/2Y-2X(N.O.)/3Y-3Z(N.C.)/5A; parallel branch 4Y-4X(N.O.)/5A; light 5 from 5A to 5B/5-. The rest contacts 1Z, 2Z, 4Z and pushbutton 3's N.O. 3X are unwired, so no sneak path exists and light 5 = (pb1 AND pb2 AND NOT pb3) OR pb4. No relay is wired. Script: D alone, then A, A x B, add C, add D, drop D, drop C, drop B; the 500 ms advance before each expect lets the lamp finish its thermal transient; the page states no timing. ER-09 is prose for the earlier A X B(not) = C paragraph and changes no wire.
